we have identified minimal standards for simulation scenarios to be used for the rigorous evaluation of MANET routing protocols, and we have provided several such scenarios that can be used to perform this evaluation.

(1) simulation-based MANET protocol evaluation is a complex and time-consuming process that requires a great deal of expertise; (2) simulation scenarios must be carefully designed and selected to be effective in protocol evaluation; (3) the scenarios used in many published MobiHOC studies do not meet minimal standards that would allow them to be considered rigorous; and (4) we have proposed minimal standards for rigorous evaluation, and we have provided simulation scenarios that meet those minimal standards.
